name: Formed on The X Factor
detail: Five solo auditioners were combined on season 2; named Fifth Harmony in November after performing as 1432

name: Finished third on The X Factor
detail: December, final song The Beatles' Let It Be

name: Demi Lovato Neon Lights Tour
detail: Opening act; also on the American Music Awards red carpet

name: The Reflection Tour
detail: First major tour, announced January 7, 2015; ran into 2016

name: The 7/27 Tour
detail: June 22, 2016 to April 8, 2017; 72 shows. The Asian leg was announced after Cabello left

name: Camila Cabello leaves
detail: Announced December 19, the day after the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball date in Florida. Billboard's timeline places their last quintet show at New Year's Rockin' Eve instead

name: PSA Tour
detail: Listed in the 7/27 Tour article's tour chronology, 2017 to 2018

name: Normani signs a solo deal
detail: October, per a later Complex report

name: Hiatus announced
detail: March 19: the four members announce an indefinite break to pursue solo work, after finishing planned shows

name: Reunion talks reported
detail: The Hollywood Reporter, May 29: talks to reunite without Cabello around the 10th anniversary of 7/27

name: Surprise reunion performance
detail: Ally Brooke, Normani, Dinah Jane and Lauren Jauregui joined the Jonas Brothers in Dallas on August 31 for Worth It and Work from Home

name: Anniversary teaser
detail: July 24: the group's Instagram, silent for over 10 months, posts a teaser for the formation anniversary. Nothing further was confirmed in the sources found
